public.title: Promise.all
public.description: Use a deterministic promise-settlement adapter. Each item is {delay,status,value}; delay is an integer from 0 through 100, status is "fulfilled" or "rejected", and value is a scalar. All items start at time zero; settlements at equal delay use input order. At most 20 items. Return {status,value,time}; represent a permanently pending aggregate as {status:"pending",value:null,time:null}. This tests aggregation rules, not native microtask scheduling. Implement all: succeed at the last settlement with values in input order; fail at the first rejection. Empty input fulfills with [] at time 0. Supported inputs are dense JSON values only: at most 100 total nodes, nesting depth at most 6, each string at most 80 UTF-16 code units, and integers from -1000 through 1000 unless narrower bounds are given. Unless the adapter explicitly defines path keys or another key format, object keys are nonempty ASCII letters without dots. All keys exclude prototype-related names. Inputs are valid; no validation is requested. Array order matters, object key order does not. Return a JSON value; no browser or third-party library is available. The complete serialized argument array is limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, counting JSON escaping. These whole-input limits also apply to descriptors, operations and nested values.
